name: llm-proxy-lab
description: Companion lab for the Back4app blog post 'How to Call an LLM API Without Exposing Your API Key': one Cloud function (askLlm) fronts the provider, the key never ships to the client, and every claim is reproduced by a test or a measurement script. Phase A runs everything against a deterministic local provider simulator — no real LLM provider is called.
author: Back4app Engineering
